lines.en: - Come on! - Hey, hey, whoa, whoa!
You want some of this, huh? You want a piece of this, huh?
I'm standing here, huh?
Hey, hey, those guys are taking our stuff!
Hey! Hey!
Get out of the way! Hey!
God, that was, that was amazing! That was incredible!
You guys, you guys kicked butt!
Us, what about you guys?
Man, you really, bing, gave it to old Mr. Clean back there.
- He was a big guy. - Yeah, he was, wasn't he?
You know, I wouldn't know, having missed everything.
Oh, you don't do that to yourself.
Any one of us could have tripped over that little girl's jump rope.
So, listen, guys, are we, uh, are we okay here?
- We're okay. - All right.
Okay, so, can I have my hat back?
No.
Huh.
- I'm not. - I'm not.
